hooks.name: Tests on save
hooks.description: Run the test suite whenever any fellowship/ module is saved.

hooks.name: Floorplan preview
hooks.description: Regenerate the floorplan preview and run the floorplan tests when the generator changes.

action.command: python -c "from fellowship import floorplans; floorplans.floorplans_preview('results/floorplans_preview.png')" && python -m pytest -q tests/test_floorplans.py

hooks.name: Smoke training
hooks.description: Run a one-iteration smoke train when a training script changes.

hooks.name: README sync
hooks.description: Sync the README results block when a results file changes.

hooks.name: Steering check
hooks.description: Check a fellowship/ change against the product steering doc: any new reported number must come from held-out seeds (>=5000) and state episode count and std.

action.prompt: A file under fellowship/ was just saved. Read .kiro/steering/product.md. If this change adds or alters any reported performance number (rescued, explored, drones lost, firefighter score, burned fraction), verify that number was produced from held-out seeds (5000 and up), never training seeds, and that it is reported with the number of episodes and the standard deviation. If a number violates this, flag exactly which one and why. If the change reports no numbers, say so and do nothing else.
